difficulty_reason: Reduce to X = [U/R]; |U| -> |X| surjective by characterize-surjective; R = U x_X U 2-cartesian, so points-cartesian makes |R| -> |U| x_|X| |U| surjective; the image of |R| -> |U| x |U| is exactly the same-image relation, giving the quotient description.
